name: fn_invoice_lines: lines of every invoice, ordered by line_no
source_sql: SELECT l.invoice_id AS invoice_id, l.line_no AS line_no, l.line_type AS line_type, l.amount AS amount FROM invoice_lines l ORDER BY l.invoice_id, l.line_no

name: invoice totals per tenant (sum of TOTAL, count)
source_sql: SELECT tenant_id AS tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(total) AS total FROM invoices GROUP BY tenant_id

name: RPT-114 join: finance feed lines whose header exists, per batch
source_sql: SELECT h.batch_no AS batch_no, COUNT(*) AS n_lines, SUM(l.amount) AS amt FROM invoice_header h, invoice_line l WHERE h.invoice_id = l.invoice_id GROUP BY h.batch_no

name: orphan finance feed lines (no header): count
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_orphans FROM invoice_line l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invoice_header h WHERE h.invoice_id = l.invoice_id)
